title: Concept: Possible a encryption salt literal assigned to ENCRYPTION_SALT in source
description: a encryption salt literal assigned to ENCRYPTION_SALT in source is key material, not a password: whoever reads it can reproduce every signature, token or ciphertext the key authorises. Retiring the key is the only remediation that survives the exposure.
applicability: Source, configuration, IaC variables and CI files that may embed a encryption salt literal assigned to ENCRYPTION_SALT.
risk: Forged signatures, decryptable data or an impersonated service identity for as long as the key is trusted; HIGH severity.
